proposals.evidence: DEDR2594 gives Tamil ciṉṉa small/little and Malayalam cinna small, cinnan a short man. Southern survey cinna/tsinna and neuter tsinnadɨ/tsinnutɨ short are comparative variants of that explicit small/short family, retaining source affricate notation and endings. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR1839 gives Tamil kuḷḷaṉ short man, Malayalam kuḷḷan/kūḷan short/stunted and Kannada kuḷḷu shortness, kuḷḷa a short man. Selected survey kūḷe/kuḷḷa/kuḷan short responses match that contracted shortness family; DEDR cross-refers to kuṟu but these use the specific kuḷḷam entry. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
